response.sql:
WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_bandusagepct,
       s.avg_bandusagepct - o.avg_bandusagepct AS difference
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.avg_bandusagepct > o.avg_bandusagepct
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is across all telescope records, with SQLite AVG ignoring NULL bandwidth values; each station average includes all of its telescope records.
